parent_decision: Do not write helper sources, build or start emulator in batch6. The actual Spotless fix and #2206 CI are the current work unit; this plan is deferred.

prior_report.reuse: The exact AppCompat1.7.1 hasValue(windowActionBar) predicate, AOSP theme-copy semantics, public WindowInspector approach, real popup path and adjudication table remain as documented there. This file records only an implementation-size refinement and public API checks.

files_if_authorized_for_future_unit: ime-context-probe/AndroidManifest.xml (instrumentation target com.osfans.trime.debug; exported dedicated editor Activity with android:process=":editor")
implementation_delta.editor: Independent helper APK Activity/remote :editor process provides a single EditText with a fictitious fixed draft, requests focus and showSoftInput. It must not share the target IME process or supply its Activity Context to any target widget. Use explicit helper-package component and a nonce. Root starts it with adb after READY; close uses explicit helper-only close Intent handled by onNewIntent/finish. Do not attempt to launch non-exported production Activities.
implementation_delta.instrumentation: Run in the target IME process. First execute and await a main Handler barrier before any AppPrefs/ThemeManager/static reference. Emit READY through sendStatus, then poll main WindowInspector for exactly one attached/shown positive-size InputView with non-null token. Enforce bounded traversal (max1600 nodes/depth24) and require service.currentInputStarted, isInputViewShown, non-null currentInputConnection, and currentInputEditorInfo.packageName == helper editor package.
implementation_delta.actual_context_capture: Use public InputView.service and themedContext; find actual attached/shown KeyboardView descendant and its public popup.root. Record identities/ownership, actual Context class and bounded ContextWrapper base chains (max12, identity loop guard), density/uiMode/display, exact AppCompat hasValue(windowActionBar), separately boolean and peekValue/resourceName, always recycle TypedArray. Never setTheme/applyStyle, create a Service, manually call onCreateInputView, reflect private service/window state, or create a RimeSession.
implementation_delta.optional_real_popup: Only after the real window/context preconditions pass: match KeyboardWindow.currentKeyboard.keys popup list exactly [TrimeWiki,Settings], with matching attached KeyView child ID/index/count. Derive screen coordinates from getLocationOnScreen, require global visible rect contains center and display0. Mark phase, inject touchscreen ACTION_DOWN through Instrumentation.sendPointerSync on worker, then poll actual PopupDelegate.root for newly attached PopupKeyboardUi key subtree/expected labels and AppCompatImageView instances. Capture exact effective ImageView contexts even if hidden. No direct construction/callback substitutes count as this path.
implementation_delta.no_up_safety: Never inject ACTION_UP: default selected action is Wiki. Keep original downTime and pointer center for mandatory ACTION_CANCEL in finally whenever DOWN may have been accepted; recycle every MotionEvent. If no matching key/window/new subtree is reached, record PRECONDITION_NOT_REACHED or WINDOW_CONTEXT_ONLY, not a popup pass. Verify no editor draft change, no external Activity launch, and popup dismissal. A second CANCEL or public popup.dismissAll fallback must be explicitly recorded as fallback, not normal-path acceptance.
implementation_delta.preference_policy: Helper writes no theme, layout, storage or feedback preference and does not manually initialize Application/AppPrefs. Root captures complete logical preferences before and after; only explicitly adjudicated general__pid change may differ. Actual IME lifecycle can legitimately write preferences, so do not assert full-byte preservation without readback.
implementation_delta.limits: No physical device/API21/Chinese input/TalkBack/Release acceptance follows from this API35 diagnostic. Raw targetContext object warnings remain a separate synthetic negative-control classification. Actual window context alone does not prove popup construction or absence of ThemeUtils logs.

budget_and_restore_gate.estimated_source_work: 15–20 minutes after Root chooses this as a work unit; helper compilation approximately1–2 minutes in prepared cached worktree, not yet performed.
budget_and_restore_gate.timeout_contract: All waits remain worker-side polling; never block main waiting for editor or coroutine long-press. Every main operation has a bounded latch and failures are returned as diagnostics. Overall deadline is not permission to claim CANCEL succeeded: if main/injection blocks and finally cannot finish, mark cleanup incomplete and fail.
root_before_gate: No Gradle/other owned emulator; one isolated API35 working-copy VM only; existing host memory floor retained.
Hash-bind original CI APK, any payload-identical signing copy, helper APK and source producer tree before start. Keep continuous raw logcat before instrumentation starts.

Save exact default and enabled IME lists, private sentinel and full logical prefs from the disposable fixture. Root owns adb ime enable/set, starts editor only after helper READY. Do not change user desktop/indexer processes.
root_finally_gate: Wait for explicit helper CANCEL/dismissal and editor-close receipts before considering diagnostic success.

Restore exact prior default IME (normally Latin) and enabled IME list, close only helper editor, verify logical prefs/sentinel and no external action. Capture failures; never silently overwrite target app state with an old entire preference file.
If helper hard deadline or main injection blocks, do not call it clean success; Root may terminate the owned target/helper process and stop owned VM normally, preserving raw failure evidence.
Stop/await owned VM and collector; verify no residual build/VM processes. A failed cleanup/runtime precondition is not a production ThemeUtils bug.

facts: BaseInputView constructor exposes val service/rime/scope and val themedContext; no private service lookup is needed.
InputView DI binds ContextThemeWrapper to themedContext and adds popup.root below actual InputView.
KeyboardView exposes val popup and val service, and creates KeyView children in keys order assigning id=index.
KeyboardWindow companion exposes lateinit currentKeyboard; read it only after actual attached KeyboardView/session discovery, never during helper startup.
TrimeInputMethodService.onCreateInputView can defer; on success it internally replaces/sets input views and returns null, so helper must not call it manually.
